visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a sleeveless pink dress with a bow, stands in a public park area with grey square floor tiles and green trees. She holds a folded black electronic device and smiles directly at the camera. (2) She unfolds the device into a large square tablet-sized screen and performs various selfie poses, tilting the device to show its thin profile and multiple folding joints. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the device's rear, showing three vertical camera lenses. A blue device is placed underneath for comparison. Yellow and white text subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) A screen recording sequence demonstrates the dual-pane camera interface, showing a live viewfinder on the right and a photo review area on the left. The woman's hands are visible interacting with the touch controls. (5) The woman sits on a park bench, holding the unfolded device vertically. The screen displays a split-view with her face on the left and a cartoon sloth from 'Zootopia' on the right. She mimics the sloth's wide-mouthed expression. (6) A final close-up comparison shows two folded devices of different sizes stacked together. The video concludes with an extreme close-up of the woman's surprised facial expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Galaxy Z TriFold 拍照效果怎麼樣. [Logo]: @aottergirls. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們來實測給你看. (3) [Subtitle]: 首先 Galaxy Z TriFold 跟 Z Fold 7. (4) [Subtitle]: 相機規格其實都相同. (5) [Subtitle]: 那拍照起來還有區別嗎？. (6) [Subtitle]: 2 億畫素主鏡頭. (7) [Subtitle]: 1,200 萬畫素超廣角鏡頭. (8) [Subtitle]: 3 倍長焦鏡頭. (9) [Subtitle]: 兩支手機就算拍很遠都還是很清楚. (10) [Subtitle]: 但拍照的體驗還是有差喔. (11) [Subtitle]: 兩摺跟三摺最大的區別當然就是操作畫面變大啦. (12) [Subtitle]: 拍遠處時左邊有即時檢視區域. [Variety]: 即時檢視區域. (13) [Subtitle]: 右邊預覽拍照畫面. [Variety]: 拍照預覽畫面. (14) [Subtitle]: 當然三摺更清楚. (15) [Subtitle]: 前置鏡頭是 1,000 萬畫素大家也可以看一看拍出來的效果喔. (16) [Subtitle]: 那我覺得最好用的是右邊可以放上想模仿的圖片. (17) [Subtitle]: 像我就放了動物方程式的樹懶. (18) [Subtitle]: 不覺這樣超方便的嗎？. (19) [Subtitle]: 而且修圖操作空間更大. (20) [Subtitle]: 就不用擔心眼睛很累啦. (21) [Subtitle]: 兩摺跟三摺相比之下尺寸差異還是很明顯的喔. [Variety]: 尺寸差異. (22) [Subtitle]: 那你覺得三摺機拍照如何歡迎底下留言.
